definitions.explanation: A morally good person, as opposed to a wicked one. A somewhat bookish word, common in stories, religion and moral talk; everyday speech says いい{人|ひと}.

examples.english: He's a good person to the core.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{善人|ぜんにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{出|で}てこない→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: Not a single good person appears in this film.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世|よ}の{中|なか}→世の中：03666_yononaka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{善人|ぜんにん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{悪人|あくにん}→悪人：29116_akunin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦はっきり→はっきり：01228_hakkiri⟧⟦{分|わ}けられる→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧ほど⟦{単純|たんじゅん}→単純：03414_tanjun⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: The world isn't so simple that people can be neatly divided into good and bad.

notes:
⟦{善|ぜん}→善：00465_zen⟧ (good) + ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ (person).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {善人|ぜんにん}ぶる: to act the good person, to pretend to be virtuous
- {善人|ぜんにん}なおもて⟦{往生|おうじょう}→往生：12704_oujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とぐ、いわんや⟦{悪人|あくにん}→悪人：29116_akunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧や: "even the good are reborn in the Pure Land, so how much more the wicked"; a famous saying of the monk Shinran

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a nice person; the everyday word
- お⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧よし: a too-trusting, easily used person
- ⟦{悪人|あくにん}→悪人：29116_akunin⟧: wicked person; the opposite
